name: Is it worth installing interior baseboard trim in a garage?

mainEntity.name: Is it worth installing interior baseboard trim in a garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing interior garage baseboards is practical if you use your garage as a workshop, finished storage area, or living space, but it may be unnecessary for an unfinished utility garage. Baseboards protect the bottom edge of drywall from impact from lawn equipment, vehicle tires, and water. If you choose to install interior trim, keeping it slightly elevated off the concrete floor or using moisture-proof PVC prevents ground water and snow runoff from wicking into the drywall. For raw, unfinished garages with bare studs, focusing budget on exterior weatherproofing trim makes more sense.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, if your garage has finished drywall or functions as a workshop, baseboards protect wall edges from water and impacts. Unfinished garages rarely need interior baseboards.
